native_phase.interpretation: Observed seed-feasibility flag is false with empty common uniform-scale intervals; solver numerical flags and raw timing controls remain finite. The false initialization is followed by finish rejection, infinite uniform duration, and NaN times. The native finish kernel intentionally writes NaN sentinel states on unsuccessful lanes. This narrows the observed failure to the seed-feasibility/initialization gate, but does not prove why the geometric candidates lack an admissible seed scale or rule out graph/buffer effects.

source_semantics.fused_coefficients_and_seed_bounds: computes path-wide scalar squared-speed scaling interval intersecting velocity, acceleration, jerk, and signed torque bounds; zero dynamic torque term additionally requires gravity within limits
source_semantics.fused_seed: reduces upper bounds with min and lower bounds with max; seed_feasible requires a nonempty positive interval (or valid fixed-start reference)
source_semantics.fused_output_status: requires initialized and input_valid; unsuccessful duration becomes infinity
source_semantics.fused_output_finalize: writes NaN to integrated time and states when success is false
source_semantics.qualification: observational post-finalizer values; not causal proof or continuous-time validation
